purpose: Stress the already frozen v2 defenders under imperfect observations; no algorithm tuning or selection on these results.
observation_model: On nonterminal steps independently flip decoy to empty, or empty/hint to decoy, with probability error_rate. Explorer and defender receive the same observed response. True target reach always ends the episode. Error stream is separate from all v2 world/action streams.
pairing: Same worlds, actions and sensor uniforms across error rates/policies within each condition/agent; independent seed namespaces between condition/agent pairs.
threshold: Use selected threshold from results_v2/frozen.json without changes.
uncertainty: Wilson rate CIs, paired normal difference CIs exploratory; simultaneous Hoeffding intervals for all row differences vs fixed_anchor, mean fixed_A/B/C/D and same-policy zero-error counterpart, family alpha=0.05.
limits: Error rates are designed stresses, not measured real-world sensor error. No target mobility or false target success. Repeated evaluation conditions are known stresses, not a new tuning holdout.
